verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS product like Trello. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out control. The cited items cover integrations, Power-Ups, API auth and account-migration complaints, none of which is about telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
